description: The Pro economic size (the IEC 60287-3-2 method): the energy lost a year in this size and one and two sizes up, its present cost over the years, and the discounted payback of the larger size where its extra cost is given, each step with its formula and source. Always paid: the site shows it to members only. input: {amps (first-year maximum load), hours (a year in service), mu (loss-load factor), price (per kWh), years, interest (%), lengthM, ambientC, freq?, extra?: [one size up, two sizes up] (extra cost per metre)}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; no free allowance; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.
